skill.name: computer-vision-expert
skill.description: Guides design and optimization of computer vision pipelines for detection, segmentation, VLM reasoning, depth estimation, and edge deployment.
skill.summary: Plan and optimize modern computer vision systems for real-time, spatial, and edge use cases.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown inline-code backticks around related skill names in SKILL.md line 70. No evidence found of command execution, prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable code.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 70 uses Markdown inline-code backticks to list related skill names. It is not Ruby or shell execution syntax and contains no executable command path.

content.value_statement: Modern vision projects require choices across detection, segmentation, VLMs, depth, and deployment. This skill guides architecture, model selection, optimization, and edge deployment for practical computer vision systems.
actual_capabilities: Recommends vision pipeline architectures for detection, segmentation, VLM reasoning, depth estimation, and reconstruction.
Compares model approaches such as YOLO-style detection, promptable segmentation, visual grounding, and depth estimation.
Advises on edge deployment topics including ONNX, TensorRT, NPU targets, latency, and memory tradeoffs.
Identifies design risks such as motion blur, text ambiguity, calibration drift, and hardware compatibility.
Helps structure evaluation plans for accuracy, latency, small-object performance, and spatial measurement quality.
limitations: Does not include model weights, datasets, benchmark results, or executable training code.
Requires the user to provide project goals, hardware limits, data examples, and deployment constraints.
Cannot verify future model claims without current documentation or empirical testing.
Does not replace domain validation for safety-critical or regulated vision systems.

use_cases.title: Plan an Inspection Pipeline
use_cases.description: Design detection, segmentation, and measurement steps for visual quality inspection with clear latency and accuracy targets.

use_cases.title: Choose Models for Product Features
use_cases.description: Compare detector, segmenter, VLM, and depth options before committing to a computer vision roadmap.

use_cases.title: Optimize Edge Deployment
use_cases.description: Prepare a vision model for constrained devices by reviewing export formats, memory use, batching, and hardware acceleration.

prompt_templates.title: Select a Vision Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a computer vision approach for this project: [goal], [data], [latency], [hardware]. Compare detection, segmentation, VLM, and depth options.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Inspection Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a visual inspection pipeline for [object] defects. Include capture setup, model stages, evaluation metrics, failure modes, and deployment constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Edge Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my edge deployment plan for [model], [device], [latency target], and [memory limit]. Suggest export, quantization, and profiling steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review Multimodal Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this multimodal vision architecture: [architecture summary]. Find accuracy, latency, calibration, data, safety, and maintenance risks.

output_examples.input: Need a factory inspection pipeline for small bolt defects on an edge GPU.
output_examples.output: Recommend a two-stage pipeline: real-time detection for candidate regions, segmentation for defect boundaries, and calibration checks for measurement accuracy. Profile edge latency before changing training strategy.

output_examples.input: Need visual question answering for warehouse shelf audits with uncertain lighting.
output_examples.output: Use a VLM for semantic checks, a detector for item localization, and lighting normalization during capture. Validate against shelf-level accuracy and exception review time.

output_examples.input: Need depth estimates for robot navigation from a single camera.
output_examples.output: Start with monocular depth for scene priors, then add calibration, temporal smoothing, and obstacle-specific validation. Treat absolute distance estimates as safety-critical measurements.

best_practices: State the target hardware, frame rate, accuracy goal, and acceptable failure rate before comparing models.
Use representative image samples and edge cases when asking for pipeline or evaluation advice.
Separate model selection, capture design, calibration, validation, and deployment planning into explicit steps.
anti_patterns: Choosing a large foundation model before defining latency, memory, and data constraints.
Relying on text prompts alone when object labels, lighting, scale, or position are ambiguous.
Skipping calibration and measurement validation in systems that depend on spatial accuracy.

faq.question: Does this skill run computer vision models?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for architecture, model selection, optimization, and evaluation planning.

faq.question: Can it help with edge deployment?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review ONNX, TensorRT, NPU, latency, memory, and quantization tradeoffs.

faq.question: Does it support segmentation workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers promptable segmentation, mask refinement, and text-guided object isolation concepts.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the task goal, data type, hardware, latency target, accuracy target, and known failure cases.

faq.question: Can it replace empirical benchmarking?
faq.answer: No. It can plan benchmarks, but real performance must be measured on representative data and hardware.

faq.question: Is it suitable for safety-critical systems?
faq.answer: It can support planning, but safety-critical systems require formal validation, monitoring, and expert review.
